title: UniversalHeadPowers
description: A datapack that adds effects to the mob's heads when they are in the player's left hand.
body:
Universal Head Powers is a Minecraft datapack that gives new purpose to mob heads.

When you place any supported mob head in your off-hand (left hand), you will receive special potion effects that remain active until the head is removed. Each type of head gives different, useful effects, making mob heads more valuable and fun to use.

⚙️ How to install the datapack:

Launch Minecraft

Go to Singleplayer

Select a world (but don’t enter it)

Click Edit

Click Open World Folder

Open the datapacks folder

Move the UniversalHeadPowers.zip file into the datapacks folder

Enter the world

Type /reload in the chat to activate the datapack

✅ That’s it! The datapack should now work automatically.

💡Supported heads and effects:
(See screenshots for a visual reference — each head gives different effects when held in the off-hand!)
